subject: Charged twice
body: Hi, my card was charged twice for the October invoice (INV-2207). Can you refund the duplicate?

subject: Invoice copy
body: Could you send me a PDF copy of last month's invoice? Our accountant needs it for the VAT return. Not urgent.

subject: Webhooks failing
body: Since this morning every webhook delivery to our endpoint returns a timeout on your side. Our order sync is stopped and customers are waiting.

subject: Dashboard slow
body: The analytics dashboard takes about 20 seconds to load. Everything works, it's just slow. Any idea why?

subject: Can't log in
body: I reset my password three times and still get 'invalid credentials'. I have a client demo in two hours and can't get in.

subject: Add a teammate
body: How do I invite a colleague and give her admin rights?

subject: Enterprise quote
body: We're evaluating you for 400 seats. Could someone send a quote for the annual plan and tell us about SSO?

subject: Strange login alert
body: I got an email about a new sign-in from a city I've never been to. It wasn't me. I've changed my password but I'm worried someone saw our customer list.

subject: Our data is public?
body: A customer just sent me a link to one of our private reports that opens without logging in. How is that possible? Please fix immediately.

subject: Final warning
body: This is the third time you've billed us after we cancelled. If the money isn't returned by Friday our attorney will file in small-claims court.

subject: GDPR request
body: Under GDPR I request a copy of all personal data you hold about me. If I don't hear back within the statutory period I will contact the data protection authority.

subject: Thanks!
body: Just wanted to say the new export feature saved me hours this week. Great work, team.

subject: Out of office
body: I am out of the office until 14 October with limited access to email. For urgent matters contact my colleague.

subject: Downgrade question
body: If I move from Pro to Basic in the middle of the month, do I get a prorated credit?

subject: Moving to a competitor
body: Your price went up 40% and the competitor offers the same for less. Unless you can do something on price we'll cancel at renewal next month.

subject: API 500s
body: POST /v2/orders returns HTTP 500 for about 10% of requests since your deploy at 09:00 UTC. Request ids attached. This is production.

subject: Feature idea
body: It would be nice if reports could be scheduled weekly. Just a suggestion, no rush.

subject: Locked out after 2FA phone loss
body: I lost my phone and with it my two-factor codes. I can't sign in at all and payroll runs tomorrow.

subject: Card expired
body: Our card on file expired and we got a payment failure email. How do I update it without losing service?

subject: Not asking for money back
body: I'm not asking for a refund, I just want to understand why this month's invoice is higher than usual.

subject: Close my account
body: Please delete my account and all my data. I no longer use the service.

subject: Phishing email
body: I received an email that looks like it's from you asking me to 'verify billing' on a strange domain. Is this real? Some of my team may have clicked it.

subject: Seats for a new team
body: We're onboarding a new team of 12 next week. Can we add seats now and get the volume discount?

subject: Sync stopped
body: Calendar sync stopped working yesterday. Not a big deal for me, but I thought you should know.

subject: Everything is down
body: Nothing loads. The app, the API, the status page. We're losing orders every minute. Please call me.

subject: Wrong VAT number
body: The VAT number on our invoices is wrong; it should be DE811234567. Please reissue the last three invoices.

subject: Student discount?
body: Do you offer a discount for students or nonprofits? We're a small charity.

subject: Ex-employee still has access
body: An employee left two weeks ago and I just noticed his account still exported data yesterday. How do I remove him and see what he took?

subject: Chargeback filed
body: I didn't recognise a charge from you so my bank opened a chargeback. Now I see it was the annual renewal. What happens now?

subject: Mobile app crash
body: The iOS app crashes as soon as I open the Projects tab. Reinstalling didn't help. Desktop works fine.

subject: Unsubscribe
body: Please stop sending me the marketing newsletter.

subject: Contract review
body: Our legal team needs your DPA and a security questionnaire answered before we can sign the enterprise contract.

subject: Billing page error
body: When I open the billing page I get 'Something went wrong' and can't download invoices. Our finance close is today.

subject: Reverse the upgrade
body: My colleague upgraded us to Business by mistake an hour ago. Can you reverse it and the charge?

subject: Password reset email never arrives
body: I requested a reset link five times and nothing arrives, not even in spam.

subject: Regulator inquiry
body: We received an inquiry from our financial regulator about where customer data is stored. We need written confirmation of your data residency by Thursday.

subject: Slow exports again
body: Exports are slow again. Same as last month. Honestly getting tired of this; we're looking at other tools.

subject: Who changed our settings?
body: Someone changed our SSO configuration overnight and nobody on our team admits to it. Logins are failing for half the company.

subject: Price for 3 more seats
body: What would it cost to add three more seats to our current plan?

subject: Duplicate account
body: I accidentally created two accounts with different emails. Can you merge them?
